end.summary:
Aditya named some toy and household solids, including cube, sphere, cone and cylinder.
They practised identifying flat and curved faces; cone and cylinder face counts were discussed.
They practised choosing solids for a toy: cylinder for the body and cone for the tip because the cylinder has a flat base.
Aditya called a matchbox a cube; this mix-up was not corrected by the last seen response.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and household objects, and sorting solids by flat and curved faces. Aditya used a ball for sphere, a rolling pin and steel glass for cylinder, and chose a cylinder and cone to build a toy, giving a reason. They mixed up a matchbox with a cube; this was not corrected later, so next time check whether all its faces are equal squares. At home, ask Aditya to find one cube and one cuboid and compare their faces.
